text.tspan: Coal energy consumption per capita vs. GDP per capita 2022
Coal energy consumption per capita is measured in megawatt-hours per person. GDP per capita is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2011 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026) and other sources
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2011 prices.
